title: Submenus of KStatusNotifierItem open to the wrong side
line: Submenus in tray icon context menus now open the first time you hover over them.
explanation: The system tray imports an app's menu over DBusMenu, but a submenu's items were only requested when Qt was about to show that submenu. The request is asynchronous, so the first popup happened while the submenu was still empty and nothing appeared; hovering off and back worked because by then the items had arrived. The change requests each submenu's layout as soon as its entry is created, so the items are already there on first hover (the existing AboutToShow refresh still handles apps that fill menus on demand).

commits.message:
libdbusmenuqt: fetch submenu contents before they are first shown

Submenu items were only requested when the submenu was about to show, so
its first popup was empty and nothing appeared until the pointer left
the item and came back. Now each submenu's layout is fetched right away.

BUG: 442877

Subject: [PATCH] libdbusmenuqt: fetch submenu contents before they are first
 shown

Submenu items were only requested when the submenu was about to show, so
its first popup was empty and nothing appeared until the pointer left
the item and came back. Now each submenu's layout is fetched right away.

BUG: 442877
---
 libdbusmenuqt/dbusmenuimporter.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/libdbusmenuqt/dbusmenuimporter.cpp b/libdbusmenuqt/dbusmenuimporter.cpp
index 7e821921de..db82decd7c 100644
--- a/libdbusmenuqt/dbusmenuimporter.cpp
+++ b/libdbusmenuqt/dbusmenuimporter.cpp
@@ -430,6 +430,7 @@ void DBusMenuImporter::slotGetLayoutFinished(QDBusPendingCallWatcher *watcher)
 
             if (QMenu *menuAction = action->menu()) {
                 connect(menuAction, &QMenu::aboutToShow, this, &DBusMenuImporter::slotMenuAboutToShow, Qt::UniqueConnection);
+                d->refresh(id);
             }
             connect(menu, &QMenu::aboutToHide, this, &DBusMenuImporter::slotMenuAboutToHide, Qt::UniqueConnection);

media.caption: Fresh app start: 'Height' hovered for over 2 s, no submenu
Fresh app start: 'Height' submenu opens on the first hover
Before: first hover shows nothing; only hovering off and back opens it
After: Height and Width open on their first hover

review.text: The cause is right (the submenu's layout is fetched asynchronously on aboutToShow and the first popup is empty), but prefetching every submenu on load is a workaround: since each fetched layout prefetches its own submenus, the whole menu tree is fetched recursively, for the global menu too (large app menus, bookmarks) on every window, and apps that fill submenus on AboutToShow still arrive empty.
changes: Keep the lazy fetch and fix the first-show case instead: when a submenu's layout arrives (menuUpdated) and its action is the parent's active action, re-popup/resize the submenu (or set the parent's active action again) so it appears.
If prefetching is kept, limit it to one level and check the global menu's D-Bus traffic.
